social_circle.name: Karen Reeves

demographics.education: Some community college with office and administrative coursework

background.how_they_met: Karen is Debra's mother and has lived with and raised her in Milwaukee.
background.why_close: Karen is Debra's main practical and emotional support, especially around college planning, health questions, errands, and anxiety.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in clear, practical full sentences, often with reminders, check-ins, and calm reassurance. Uses a few warm emojis but is not overly expressive.

recent_text_topics: Reminders about community college deadlines, financial aid information, and emailing an advisor.
Checking whether Debra got home safely when she is out walking, volunteering, or taking the bus.
Grocery lists, dinner timing, worn shoes, appointments, and small household tasks.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q01 says Debra's mom shaped her most because she is 'patient and practical' and mentions Saturday library trips. Q44 says Karen helped Debra make three next steps after graduation. Q05 and Q103 identify Karen as Debra's mother and a dental office receptionist/scheduler.

social_circle.name: Maya Thompson

demographics.occupation: Part-time coffee shop worker and community college student
demographics.education: High school diploma; enrolled in community college

background.how_they_met: Debra met Maya in high school art class.
background.why_close: They are both quiet, creative, and comfortable with low-pressure one-on-one time. Maya is the friend Debra texts when she is anxious or comparing herself to others.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts a few thoughtful messages at a time, mixes lowercase casual language with occasional long supportive paragraphs, sends photos, songs, and Instagram posts.

recent_text_topics: Debra's worries about being behind after high school and Maya saying she feels behind too.
Plans for coffee, library visits, or lake walks depending on the weather.
Art posts, songs, racial justice posts Maya shares online, and photos of Debra's baking.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 says 'My closest friend is Maya, who I met in high school art class' and that they get coffee, go to the library, or walk by the lake. Q07 follow-up says they text a few times a week. Q44 says Debra told Maya about struggling after graduation.

social_circle.name: Ethan Reeves

background.how_they_met: Ethan is Debra's younger brother and has lived in the same household with her throughout childhood.
background.why_close: They share a home, family routines, errands, and sibling familiarity, even though his gaming and noise sometimes tire Debra out.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Short, casual texts with abbreviations, memes, and quick requests. Less emotionally detailed than Debra, but responsive when he needs a ride, food, or a reminder.

shared_activities: watching TV or sports around family
recent_text_topics: Debra reminding him to take out trash, come to dinner, or check something for school.
Quick messages about whether he needs food, a ride, or help finding something at home.
Jokes about his gaming noise and family plans for weekends or summer activities.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 identifies Ethan as Debra's fifteen-year-old younger brother in high school. Q11 says Ethan's life is school, games, and friends. Q17 says Debra helps track small household things, including reminders for her brother.

social_circle.name: Linda Bauer

background.how_they_met: Linda is Debra's maternal grandmother and has been part of her family life since childhood.
background.why_close: Debra and Linda connect through family dinners, baking, local fairs, practical help, and steady family care.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts slowly and sometimes needs phone help. Sends short check-ins, asks practical questions, and may sign messages or use simple emojis.

recent_text_topics: Planning Sunday dinner times and whether Debra can bring bread or cinnamon rolls.
Asking Debra for help with her phone or a confusing message.
Summer fair plans, blood pressure appointments, rides, and grocery errands.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Debra's maternal grandma Linda is important, lives in the Milwaukee area, and they see her for Sunday dinners. Q05 follow-up says they bake together, Debra helps her with her phone, and they go to local fairs. Q35 mentions Linda's blood pressure issues and family check-ins.

social_circle.name: Jess Miller

demographics.occupation: Part-time veterinary assistant and animal shelter volunteer
demographics.education: High school diploma; some veterinary technician coursework

background.how_they_met: Jess met Debra through volunteering at the animal shelter.
background.why_close: They bond over animals, shelter routines, low-key check-ins, and a shared preference for gentle, practical care.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts casually with lots of pet photos, quick updates, and occasional emojis. More likely to send pictures than long emotional messages.

recent_text_topics: Photos of cats from the shelter and updates on which animals were adopted.
Coordinating whether either of them has an upcoming shelter shift.
Light check-ins about Debra's college planning and whether volunteering is helping her feel unstuck.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 says Debra has a friend named Jess from volunteering at the animal shelter and that they check in and send each other pictures of cats from the shelter. Q15 and Q65 describe Debra's animal shelter volunteering duties.
